answers.core:
Currently we have to write a lot of boilerplate for simple stuff.
I was trying to sync the button and label text color, but since I couldn't just set the button to a hover or focus state and since button has state the label doesn't I couldn't get it to work.

Controls are already part of core.
I would love to see them not be so hard coded and tied to desktop ui.

title: We need better support for composite controls.
